evidence.observation: Growth pressure 2.922 Torr, matching the ramp baseline of about 2.90 Torr at 100 sccm Ar
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.191 Torr (+0.27 Torr in 720 s), and the rise is speeding up
Ar flow steady at about 100 sccm, so extra flow does not explain the pressure rise
Thermocouple at 750.0 °C with heater power steady at about 45%; temperature control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so I can't check for air getting in to tell a seal leak from an exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 reading, or a leak-up/rate-of-rise test with flow stopped and the tube isolated, plus a check of the exhaust line and pump conductance. These would show whether the cause is a seal leak (air getting in) or an exhaust blockage.
